payload.label: Make content
payload.description: Binds source refs, requested outputs, and one workflow definition id into one production run without owning downstream analysis, speech, rendering, or distribution.

setup.label: Choose how to make it.
setup.detail: Start needs one saved way to run.

fallback.label: Needs review
fallback.detail: Open the latest result before starting again.

payload.execution_contract: Profile points at a workflow Definition id. The Definition composes package-owned actions through normal workflow steps and Binding AST.

payload.source_ref_contract: source_ref is an opaque durable source reference. It must point at stored bytes, artifact refs, resource refs, or package-visible handles; raw local machine paths stay inside the source package.

payload.name: content-production-prompt-to-publish-intent
payload.description: Compose one prompt into a publish intent and publish attempt through package-owned workflow actions.

payload.name: content-production-render-manifest-to-publish
payload.description: Render a selected media-composition manifest, publish the rendered artifact ref, and record analytics from the accepted publish status.

payload.name: execute-content-production-run
payload.description: Mark a production run running, ask the addressed workflow definition to execute, then mark the run complete.

payload.name: write-content-production-status
payload.description: Write one production run status record.

payload.name: write-content-production-output
payload.description: Write one production output record.

payload.name: write-content-production-error
payload.description: Write one production error record.

payload.name: video-grade
payload.description: Apply the locked a-roll vibe grade + film grain pass (grade-pass2.sh) to a base video; all grade tunables are inputs defaulting to the shipped-video values.

payload.name: slides-render
payload.description: Render every slide video from the slide-windows timing SSOT (render-slides.sh); windows file, slides dir, and output dir are inputs defaulting to the shipped-video paths.

payload.name: transcript-clean
payload.description: Repunctuate + correct a word-timed transcript via the local CLI model (clean-transcript.mjs), preserving word timings; model/chunk are env inputs defaulting to the shipped-video values.

payload.name: slides-audit
payload.description: Snap slide/chapter windows to sentence boundaries and compute read-tails (audit-slides.mjs) over the timing SSOT; thresholds are env inputs defaulting to the shipped-video values.

payload.name: thumbnail-make
payload.description: Compose the thumbnail base + serif title (make-thumbnail-base.py, make-thumbnail-title.py — already argument-driven, admitted verbatim).

payload.name: emphasis-mark
payload.description: UPPERCASE vocally-emphasized words from the audio track (emphasis-from-audio.py — already argument-driven, admitted verbatim).

payload.name: submit-content-production-run
payload.description: Write one canonical production run and queued status.

payload.name: run-media-collection-workflow
payload.description: Generic primitive: given selected media asset addresses and a goal, assemble a composition, produce a caption/article via an AI agent, persist the authored document, publish to zero or more destination rows (some immediate, some delay-scheduled), and return a summary. Every destination is an opaque DATA row (generic.target-record, role=destinations) read by reference — this action never enumerates or hardcodes a channel/provider. Dispatch per destination is itself data-driven: the destination_ref row optionally carries dispatch_action_id (which downstream action to call — defaults to action:run-publish-intent for immediate publish, or action:timed-action.write-scheduled-action for delay-scheduled destinations), plus operation/record_id/scheduled_writes fields consumed only when that destination targets timed-action. Composes existing generic packages (media-composition, ai-records-producer, documents, content-distribution, timed-action) via slot::workflow dispatch; owns zero provider-specific logic itself.

payload.name: style-talking-head-aroll-slides
payload.description: The first proven content style: grade the continuous base, render timing-SSOT slides, compose the layered EDL, master nothing (voice rides the base), return a publish intent for the named destination.

payload.name: style-audio-slides-dominant
payload.description: The second content style, pure data over the same capabilities: master the voice track, render full-frame slides from the timing data, compose with base kind slides and the mastered voice as the continuous audio, return a publish intent.

payload.name: media-classify
payload.description: Select the workflow definition (the style) for a set of inputs: data rule table first, local-CLI pick when no rule matches, manual pass-through when the caller names one.

payload.name: import-presentation-formats
payload.description: Import presentation-format DATA from an embedded JSON island without executing source-document code.

payload.name: compile-presentation-plan
payload.description: Compile one material and one presentation-format DATA row into a production plan without format-name branches.

payload.name: evaluate-presentation-readiness
payload.description: Evaluate declared setup requirements against fresh accepted evidence and connected capabilities; never authorize or start execution.

payload.name: generate-derived
payload.description: Generate one derived text deliverable (format spec is data in derived-formats.json) from a cleaned transcript via the local CLI model.

payload.name: pipeline-record-to-publish
payload.description: On a new recording: classify the input shape to a workflow definition, then execute that definition. The chosen definition produces and publishes the content; this pipeline never names a style or platform.

payload._activation: is_active:false until the user turns the automation on (Distribution/Settings); flipping it is a data write, zero code

payload.name: style-descriptor
payload.description: A cataloged make-recipe: an ordered list of package-call dispatches that produce one publishable thing. Generic - owns no domain vocabulary.
Open action address for the workflow-action row this descriptor catalogs.
Open reference to the record contract produced by the final return or write step.
Required input refs for a make-recipe.
Provenance gates such as approval and confidence requirements.
Human label for picker surfaces.
Open UI tone key supplied by DATA.

payload.name: style-swing-comparison-reel
payload.description: Side-by-side owner-vs-reference swing reel with replicated voice narration and burned captions; returns a publish intent.

payload.name: style-session-recap-reel
payload.description: Coaching session recap reel composed from session evidence, narrated in the approved voice, captioned, and returned as a publish intent.

payload.name: style-testimonial-package
payload.description: Testimonial evidence package composed into a publishable captioned video intent without owning testimonial vocabulary in code.

payload.name: style-pro-library-item
payload.description: Pro library video item composed from an authored EDL and returned as a publish intent for downstream library publication.

payload.name: style-sales-page-offer
payload.description: Sales page offer descriptor generated from source copy, written into public-sales-page DATA, then variant generation can review alternates.

payload.name: style-gated-course
payload.description: Gated course descriptor generated from source material, writing both gate and delivery target records by address.

payload.name: style-offer-variant-set
payload.description: Offer variant set generated through the variations seam and returned for review UI selection.

payload.name: style-match-analysis-product
payload.description: Match analysis product that gates low-confidence measures, creates analysis copy, composes a reel, and writes a product-access grant.

payload.name: style-corpus-product
payload.description: Provenance-backed corpus product that writes gate and material-delivery package target records.

payload.name: style-expert-corpus
payload.description: Expert corpus bundle that turns provenance records into a delivery target descriptor.

payload.name: style-measure-to-plan-doc
payload.description: Measure-derived training plan document gated by confidence and written as an ai-records-producer result.

payload.name: read-production-configuration
payload.description: Read the current package-set-owned production selections and throughput policy without naming a campaign, provider, account, or device.
